subject: Re: Quick check — Q2 close timing and budget for Acme Finance
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Bennett <olivia@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jun 2025 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + next steps (Acme Finance)

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned as you head into the quarter close:

- Challenge: Your data team highlighted unpredictable per-call latency spikes and a 3x variation in token costs across workloads.
- Redwood fit: Dedicated pools + batching/caching should stabilize tail latency and reduce per-token cost; our Optimize recommendations typically reduce unit cost 20–40% for similar profiles.
- Proposed next steps:
  1) I’ll share a tailored pricing proposal and a short runbook showing expected latency improvements for your 512–2048 token tails (attached).
  2) If helpful, we can schedule a 30-min technical validation with your infra lead next week.
  3) You indicated procurement prefers an EOM decision — any specific blocking items on your side?

Attached: redwood-pricing-proposal.pdf (pricing + config options), discovery-notes.txt

If nothing urgent blocks you, would you be open to a brief status check on Monday 23rd? Happy to adjust to your cadence.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Bennett <olivia@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps (Acme Finance)

Hi Olivia —

Just nudging this up the inbox. I know it's a busy week for you with month-end — quick yes/no on whether procurement still expects to sign before June 30 would be super helpful for our planning.

If the timeline shifted, totally understandable — if so, can you share the expected month/quarter? If you want, I can loop in our solutions engineer for one more short run-through to unblock any technical questions.

Thanks — short reply is fine: still on track for EOM?

— Vanessa

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Bennett <olivia@acme-fin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 08:04:00 -0700
Subject: Bump: timing check before EOM

Hi Olivia —

Following up again before the end of week. Two quick things we can do to help drive this forward on our side:

- Prep a concise procurement packet (1 pager + SOW summary) if that helps your procurement team move faster.
- Offer a short pilot-start window with a capped-monthly commitment to reduce perceived risk.

If procurement needs pricing redlines, we can accept simple changes to the SLA section rather than reworking the entire MSA — happy to work with your legal team directly.

Attached earlier: redwood-pricing-proposal.pdf

Would love a quick update on whether budget/approval are still prioritized for Q2.

Best,
Vanessa

From: Olivia Bennett <olivia@acme-fin.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Jun 2025 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Bump: timing check before EOM

Vanessa —

Sorry for the delay and thanks for the clear notes. Quick update from our side:

- Short version: priority has shifted slightly. We are still interested in Redwood and the solution looks like a fit, but the procurement committee asked us to push vendor commitments into Q3. The main reason is an unexpected reallocation of budget to a compliance audit that started this month.
- What we need: a 1-page procurement packet and a short clarification on data isolation (VPC option + KMS) so our security team can sign off. I shared your pricing doc with them; they want a written note we support KMS + audit logs.
- Timeline: can we target an internal go/no-go decision by mid-July? That gives us enough runway after the audit to re-open procurement conversations.

Thanks for being flexible — would appreciate the 1-pager and the isolation clarification. If you can get that over today or tomorrow, I’ll keep this moving on our side.

Best,
Olivia Bennett
Head of Platform Engineering, Acme Finance
olivia@acme-fin.com
